# Österreichischer Eishockeyverband (ÖEHV)

> > Official website of the Austrian Ice Hockey Federation covering national teams, domestic leagues, player development programs, and international competitions.

The ÖEHV (Österreichischer Eishockeyverband) governs ice hockey in Austria, managing national teams across all age groups and genders, overseeing domestic competitions including the win2day AWHL (women's league), Alps Hockey League, and regional divisions, while promoting youth development through initiatives like the PEER kindergarten recruitment program.

## Key Topics

- ÖEHV (Österreichischer Eishockeyverband)
- Austrian National Teams (Nationalteam)
- IIHF World Championships (WM)
- win2day AWHL (Austrian Women's Hockey League)
- Alps Hockey League
- PEER Program (Kindergarten Recruitment)
- RED+ (National Team Program)
- Women's Ice Hockey (Damen-Eishockey)
- Division Ost & Division West
- WM Preparation Matches (WM-Vorbereitung)
- Inclusion Programs (Move on to Inclusion)
- Major Austrian Cities (Wien, Linz, Villach, St. Pölten)
- International Opponents (Tschechien, Deutschland, Finnland, Slowakei, Kanada)
- Steffl Arena & Vienna Capitals
